scripts.lighthouse: pnpm --filter @coschema/server build && pnpm --filter @coschema/editor build && tsx bench/lighthouse/main.ts
scripts.test:e2e:postgres: pnpm --filter @coschema/server build && pnpm --filter @coschema/editor build && tsx scripts/e2e-postgres.ts
